result.edit: Replace the sum assignment `assign s=(a|b|ci);` with the correct XOR-based full-adder sum `assign s=(a^b^ci);`. The OR expression incorrectly produced 1 whenever any input was high (e.g., 11 instead of 10 for a=1,b=1,ci=0), matching the observed first divergence at cycle 3. Carry logic is unchanged.
